base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cosy circular kitchen-laboratory inside the lighthouse with curved copper walls, a mirror-polished salvage-metal table, a kettle, a ceiling fan, an armchair, half-finished gadgets everywhere, coiled cables, and a chaotic workbench. Lighting: warm morning light through round porthole windows.
In the shot: Marvel, an ancient, kindly, slightly stooped wizard with a huge floor-length grey beard tinged with patches of green moss, bushy eyebrows, twinkling eyes, patchwork robes stitched from three different historical eras (medieval velvet, Victorian brocade, 1970s paisley), an absurdly tall pointed wizard hat that nearly scrapes the ceiling, and a gnarled wooden staff.
Camera: Medium shot at the kettle.
Action: Marvel lifts the kettle, peers into it, and tips it upside down: not a single drop of water comes out. He raises one bushy eyebrow.
Dialogue: Marvel the Wizard (deep, warm, sonorous elderly male voice with a theatrical storyteller's cadence, slow and serene, narrating himself in the third person, wry narration) says: "Marvel notes the kettle is not yet boiled. He wonders if the cat drank all the hot water again."
Sound effects: hollow kettle clank, single sad drip, ambience of ticking gadgets, fridge hum, distant waves.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
